newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures mixed, June T-bond cuts losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures mixed, June T-bond cuts losses.

text.p: May 22 - U.S. debt futures were mixed, and the June bond cut losses after the March FOMC minutes were released. Minutes showed Fed policy makers voted 10-0 to up rates, saw clear need for pre-emptive strike. FOMC felt March rise would pose little risk to expansion. Traders said market still edgy, rangebound.
